verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace (CLI, API, SDK). It is not an agent or LLM host that would consume tools from MCP servers, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. The only MCP evidence is Lium's own docs MCP server at `/mcp`. That is the server role, not MCP-client support, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
